title: The boundary is substitutable via the framework interface so tests exercise it without booting the whole stack
asA: test author verifying that a specific exception produces the expected record
iWant: the boundary contract to expose a substitutable interface so a test can exercise the error-handling path without booting the full framework
soThat: boundary tests are hermetic and fast

acceptanceCriteria.description: TAC-1701 exposes a boundaryFor({ loggerFactory, transportWriter }) -> { handle(err, context) } function the framework registers as its handler; a test constructs the boundary with a stub loggerFactory and a stub transportWriter, invokes handle(err, context), and asserts the observed loggerFactory calls and the observed transportWriter calls.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a stub loggerFactory and a stub transportWriter
acceptanceCriteria.when: the test invokes handle with a synthetic exception
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stub loggerFactory records one error() call with the constructed record and the stub transportWriter records one write with the mapped wire body
